newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Spector says outlook better than ever.
newsitem.headline: Spector says outlook better than ever.

text.p: Belgian photoprocessing group Spector Photo Group NV, which sees the turnaround at its Swiss unit Photo Porst as its main challenge for 1997, said on Wednesday its potential for profit was distinctly rosy.
"With a consolidated turnover of 26 billion Belgian francs, our profit potential per share is better than ever," chief executive officer Johan Mussche said in the 1996 annual report.

He said Spector had created room to successfully put Photo Porst "back on the right track" partly through Spector's capital increase of October 1996 which ensured that the Porst takeover was "not a real financial risk".
The strong improvement on Spector's bargaining position on the commodities market was also offering the group an excellent outlook both on the financial level as in its competitive position.
